export const meta = {
  name: 'konusulacaklar-guncelle',
  description: 'Update the Konuşulacaklar agenda page from its 23 Oct state to 28 Oct, topic by topic with evidence',
  phases: [{ title: 'Check', detail: 'three auditors split the 17 system sections' }, { title: 'Write', detail: 'one writer produces the updated page' }],
}
const PU = '/Users/tugbauysal/Desktop/project steam/Project Unicorn/project-unicorn'
const MEM = '/Users/tugbauysal/.claude/projects/-Users-tugbauysal-Desktop-project-steam-Project-Unicorn/memory'
const PAGE = PU + '/docs/strateji/konusulacaklar/index.html'
const OUT = '/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-tugbauysal-Desktop-project-steam/6d15b35f-66f1-4e87-b274-dc8c31d2f7b4/scratchpad/konusulacaklar_v2.html'
const SOURCES = `Evidence sources (read what you need, cite file:line or commit sha):
- git history since the page was written: run \`git -C "${PU}/.." log --since=2026-10-23 --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short\` and read full messages of relevant commits with \`git show -s <sha>\`.
- Owner's verbatim decisions: ${PU}/docs/tasks/faz_cde/ERDEM_KARARLAR_2026-10-20.md (sections dated 2026-10-24..27).
- Co-director state: ${MEM}/codirector-state-2026-10-26.md, ${MEM}/codirector-state-2026-10-28.md, ${MEM}/faz-d-ekip-sprint-task-2026-10-18.md, ${MEM}/olaylar-uygulama-2026-10-26.md, ${MEM}/temizlik-task-2026-10-26.md, ${MEM}/urun-arayuzu-devam-2026-10-26.md, ${MEM}/feedback-*.md.
- PRDs and reports: ${PU}/docs/tasks/PRD_URUN_SPRINT_ARAYUZU.md (sections "Erdem'in A4 cevabı" and "Erdem'in 2026-10-28 kararları"), ${PU}/docs/tasks/GOREV_OLAY_UYGULAMA.md (decisions list, "Devir"), ${PU}/docs/tasks/faz_cde/ (RAPOR_D*, D_MODEL_v3), ${PU}/docs/tasks/DEVIR_DIZUSTU_2026-10-27.md, ${PU}/docs/ACIK_ISLER/ACIK_KARARLAR.md and ISLER.md.
- Today's (2026-10-28) owner answers, verbatim summary passed in as args.todays_answers.
Rules: a topic is "closed" only if an owner decision or a commit closes it (cite it). "changed" = still open but the question moved (say how). "obsolete" = the premise no longer exists (cite). Never invent a decision. Read-only: do not edit any repo file.`

const TOPIC_SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    sections: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: {
      id: { type: 'string' },
      status_chip: { type: 'string', enum: ['net', 'kısmen net', 'konuşulmadı'] },
      newly_settled: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: { text_tr: { type: 'string' }, source: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['text_tr', 'source'] } },
      topics: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: {
        index: { type: 'number' }, status: { type: 'string', enum: ['closed', 'changed', 'open', 'obsolete'] },
        new_text_tr: { type: 'string' }, evidence: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['index', 'status', 'evidence'] } },
      new_topics: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: { text_tr: { type: 'string' }, source: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['text_tr', 'source'] } },
      pending_work_tr: { type: 'string' },
    }, required: ['id', 'status_chip', 'topics'] } },
  },
  required: ['sections'],
}

const GROUPS = [
  ['erp', 'kart', 'arge', 'rakip', 'satis', 'hesap'],
  ['fon', 'ekip', 'arayuz', 'alim', 'gorev', 'b2c'],
  ['eko', 'pazarlama', 'iflas', 'ayarlar', 'sanat'],
]
phase('Check')
const checked = await parallel(GROUPS.map((ids, i) => () => agent(
  `You are updating a Turkish agenda page for the owner of a Godot game project. Page: ${PAGE}. It lists, per system section (section ids: ${ids.join(', ')}), "Netleşenler" (settled by owner decisions) and numbered "Konuşulacaklar" (open topics), as of 2026-10-23. For EACH topic in YOUR sections only, decide its status today (2026-10-28) with evidence, and list newly settled decisions and new open topics that belong to your sections.\n${SOURCES}\nWrite all Turkish text in plain, short sentences in the page's existing voice (addressing the owner as "sen"). Keep each new_text_tr to the length of the original topic or shorter.`,
  { label: `check:${ids[0]}…`, phase: 'Check', schema: TOPIC_SCHEMA })))

phase('Write')
const result = await agent(
  `Write the updated Konuşulacaklar page.\nInput page: ${PAGE} (read it fully; keep its CSS, tokens, fonts, structure and voice exactly; it is a Claude artifact page: no doctype/html/head/body tags, title tag first).\nAuditor results (JSON): ${JSON.stringify(checked.filter(Boolean))}\nToday's owner answers: ${args.todays_answers}\nProduce the page as of 28 Ekim 2026 and write it to ${OUT}:\n- Header eyebrow date 28 Ekim 2026; remove the "Bu, 23 Ekim'deki hâl" banner; add one short note saying what changed since 23 Ekim (counts: how many topics closed, changed, new).\n- Summary table: recount topics per section, update status chips and "Bekleyen iş".\n- "Şu an yürüyen" section: replace with today's running work: URUN_ARAYUZU session (GOREV_DIZUSTU_URUN_2026-10-28: UK, pencere genişliği, kesme taraması, U7, Yardım Merkezi, ikon bağlama, U8) and OLAYLAR session (ikon adayları, Olaylar 7c, çalışmayan etkilerin bağlanması), plus co-director's research on event pacing, the test-suite audit, the goal-display design study, and a playtest.
- Closed topics move to that section's "Netleşenler" list as one line with the decision; obsolete topics are dropped; changed topics get the new wording; new topics are appended with their source.
- Move "Önerilen PRD sırası" to match today's priority proposal in args.todays_answers.
- Every claim must come from the auditor results or today's answers. No new decisions.
- Keep Turkish natural and plain. No em dashes in prose you add.
Return a short list of the changes you made (section by section) and the final topic counts.`,
  { label: 'write:page', phase: 'Write', model: 'opus' })
return { result, out: OUT }

args.todays_answers: 2026-10-28 Erdem: (1) İşlere başlansın; iki oturum başladı. (2) Sprint ekranı: Ürün penceresi genişlesin (teyit edildi). (3) Modül ikonları: yalnız Çekirdek küp ve Güven kalkan onaylı; İlk Kullanım, Entegrasyonlar, Büyüme, Gelir reddedildi, yeni adaylar gelecek. (4) Yeşil tik yalnız tamamlanmış istekte; plandaki istek 'sürüyor' biçimiyle (kareler gelecek); satır soluk değil. (5) Kartta aşama yüzdesi (a), ad altında, durum yuvasında. (6) Modül adları: 'Kendi Kendine Servis' hattı 'Yardım Merkezi / Help Center' olur; sayfanın 3 sorusu açık. (7) Kesme ve keyfi kısıtlama yok, metin sarar; ajanlar işlerini Godot MCP ile görsel doğrular. (8) Hedef gösterimi: B yönü fena değil; Planet Zoo gibi soru işareti ve ayarların yanındaki bir düğmeye konsun, basınca ayrı görünüm açılsın, arayüzde yer kaplamasın; tasarım çalışması isteniyor. (9) Olay kartlarında çalışmayan etkiler: 'eğitime gönder' ve 'işten çıkar' oyuncunun kendi akışına bağlanabilir (Erdem bağlanmasını istiyor); 'müşteri ekle' için Erdem 'müşteri listesinde görünür' dedi ama bu 26 Ekim'deki 'olay imzalatmaz, teklif verir' kararıyla çelişiyor, soru Erdem'e gidiyor; 'kitleyi dönüştür' ve 'ücretli sürüm aç' için Erdem böyle bir olay hatırlamıyor ve neden var diye soruyor (motor sözlüğünde var, hiçbir kart kullanmıyor). (10) Kâğıt sıklığı kuralı ('en az üçte biri' yerine %7–10): Erdem bir kurala bağlamaya gerek var mı diye soruyor; Europa Universalis ve diğer oyunların olay motorlarının sıklığı nasıl kurduğu araştırılıyor. (11) project.godot sıralaması kalsın. (12) Git geçmişi yeniden yazılmayacak, repo böyle kalsın. (13) Satış ve müşteri ilişkileri Ar-Ge dalları en sona; şimdilik bekler. (14) TR/EN onay bekleyen metinler: Erdem çoğunu daha önce onayladığını, değişen şıkları playtest'te göreceğini söyledi; ayrı metin turu yok, playtest'te elden geçer. (15) Test betikleri eski ve verimsiz bulundu: testler geçiyor ama oyunda bozuk yerler çıkıyor; test sistemi baştan elden geçirilecek (önce denetim ve öneri). (16) Yardımcı yönetmen paralelde bir playtest yapacak. Öncelik önerisi (co-director, 27 Ekim): 1 süren işleri bitir ve tek karar sayfası, 2 Erdem'in oyun oturumu (ilk 30 hafta, sprint ekranı, 28 olay), 3 Pazar 2'yi kapat ve pazar/rakip PRD'si, 4 Next Fest Haziran 2027 ve demo kapsamı, 5 Steam Coming Soon (sanat yönü, kapsül), 6 metin turu (artık playtest'e bağlandı), en son öğretici ve hedefler.

result.result:
The page is written to `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-tugbauysal-Desktop-project-steam/6d15b35f-66f1-4e87-b274-dc8c31d2f7b4/scratchpad/konusulacaklar_v2.html`. A script checked it: each section's topic count matches the summary table, the total is 113, every tag is closed and there are no em dashes. The CSS, tokens and fonts are copied unchanged, and `<title>` is the first line.

**Final counts:** 17 systems, 113 topics (109 − 9 closed − 1 obsolete + 14 new). 11 topics got new wording.

| Section | Topics | Closed | Changed | New | Obsolete |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| erp | 12 | | 1 | 1 | |
| kart | 11 | | 4 | 1 | |
| arge | 8 | | | 1 | 1 |
| rakip | 8 | | | | |
| satis | 12 | | 1 | 1 | |
| hesap | 11 | | 1 | | |
| fon | 4 | | | | |
| ekip | 9 | 2 | | 3 | |
| arayuz | 3 | 6 | | 3 | |
| alim | 4 | | | 1 | |
| gorev | 4 | | 1 | 1 | |
| b2c | 3 | 1 | | 1 | |
| eko | 5 | | 2 | | |
| pazarlama | 4 | | | | |
| iflas | 4 | | | | |
| ayarlar | 3 | | | | |
| sanat | 8 | | 1 | 1 | |

**Changes by section**

- **Header:** the date line now reads 28 Ekim 2026, and the "Bu, 23 Ekim'deki hâl" banner is gone. In its place is one short note: Faz D, A4 (U2–U6), Olaylar 1–7b and Temizlik are done, and it gives the counts above.
- **Summary table:** heading is now "17 sistem, 113 konu" and all topic counts are recounted. The arayüz chip goes from "konuşulmadı" to "kısmen net". Every "Bekleyen iş" cell is updated, and Ar-Ge's PRD cell reads "1, en sona".
- **Sıra:** renamed "Önerilen sıra". It lists the co-director's 27 Ekim proposal as 7 items, says Erdem will answer the priorities later, and links each item to the sections on the page. A note names the PRDs the proposal doesn't order (2, 3, 4, 5, 7).
- **Şu an yürüyen:** now lists six items:
  - the Ürün arayüzü session (UK aşama yüzdesi, E1 pencere genişliği, "…" kesme taraması and U7, Yardım Merkezi D5, icon hookup after Erdem's pick, U8)
  - the Olaylar session (icon candidates, Olaylar 7c, hooking up "eğitime gönder" and "işten çıkar", with the other three verbs left untouched)
  - the event-pacing research
  - the test-suite audit
  - the goal-display design study
  - the co-director's playtest
- **ERP:** 2 new decisions. Topic 3 reworded (U2). New topic 12: the three module and line name questions.
- **Kart:** 5 new decisions. Topics 3, 5, 6 and 9 reworded; topic 6 keeps the old simulation figure. Topics 2, 7 and 8 now point to the card refresh in their source notes. New topic 11: the fix card's cap.
- **Ar-Ge:** header now says "konuşması en sona". 3 new decisions. Topic 7 (role-based tree) dropped as obsolete; its context moved into new topic 8, which asks about the Satış and Müşteri ilişkileri branches.
- **Rakipler:** no topic changes. Topic 5's source note mentions U2 removing the rival chip. Pending work updated.
- **Satış:** 2 new decisions. Topic 4 reworded (first-year discount, Olaylar 3). New topic 12 asks whether "müşteri ekle" from an event should add the customer directly, which conflicts with the 26 Ekim decision.
- **Hesap:** 1 new decision. Topic 1 reworded (events can now trigger a 4-week termination notice). Topic 6 gets one line of context from the evidence. Pending work now includes Olaylar 7c.
- **Fon:** 1 new decision. Topic 4 now notes that CLAUDE.md and ANA_RESIM say different things about where the demo ends. Pending work updated.
- **Ekip:** topics 1 and 8 closed; their decisions sit inside the 11 new decision lines. 3 new topics: the reputation threshold, whether the paper rate needs a rule (the Europa Universalis research), and the founder's 2★ floor. Pending work updated.
- **Arayüz:** the 6 closed topics became decision lines, plus 8 more new decisions (17 lines in all). 3 new topics: the "sürüyor" format, new icon candidates, and the U8 decisions. The dependency line is updated because the font question is settled.
- **Alım:** the Temizlik 14 desk rule is merged into the existing line, plus 2 new decisions. New topic 4: the Atlas file ignoring traits.
- **Görev:** "Henüz yok" replaced by 2 decisions (27 Ekim). Topic 3 reworded (playtest). New topic 4: where the goal display lives, with a link to the earlier research artifact.
- **B2C:** topic 3 closed ("B2C demoda kalır"), plus 2 more decisions. New topic: why the two verbs "kitleyi dönüştür" and "ücretli sürüm aç" exist when no card uses them.
- **Ekonomi:** 2 new decisions. Topics 2 and 5 reworded. Topics 1 and 4 get extra evidence in their source notes.
- **Pazarlama:** 1 new decision. **İflas:** no changes.
- **Ayarlar:** the effects slider is off and there is no effects sound in the game. The UI scale setting is added as present in the game.
- **Sanat:** 2 new decisions. Topic 4 reworded (typography is settled). Topic 2 gets the co-director's Haziran 2027 proposal and the 10 Ocak deadline. New topic 8: the source of the 91 icons blocks release.
- **Sonraya kalanlar:** the "tek metin turu" line is rewritten: there is no separate text round, and texts are reviewed during playtest. The two items that had been left for that round are marked as still open.

**Editorial calls**

- **Duplicate removed:** the auditor listed the three module-name questions as a new topic under both ERP and Arayüz. I kept it once, under ERP, and Arayüz's footer points there. With the duplicate the total would have been 114.
- **Decisions placed in one section only:** "Yardım Merkezi" is only under ERP, "Teknik etiketi" and "düzeltme kartı 2 puan" only under Kart.
- **Not re-checked:** the "Bulunan küçük hatalar" list and most of "Sonraya kalanlar" stay as they were, because the auditor didn't cover them.
- **Open tension:** the page doesn't resolve it. The proposal's item 3 needs Pazar 2's last question, the AI era (Ar-Ge topic 1). But Erdem said on 28 Ekim that the Ar-Ge discussion comes last, so it's unclear whether that question also waits.
